page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1.6xlarge is a storage-focused virtual server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 24 dedicated physical cores on an x86_64 architecture, utilizing an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz. With a 1.0 thread-per-core configuration, each of the 24 vCPUs maps directly to a dedicated physical core, ensuring consistent compute performance without resource sharing.

The hardware configuration includes 96.0 GB of system memory, providing 4.0 GB of RAM per core. A key characteristic of this instance is its massive bundled local storage, offering 70,866 GB of HDD capacity. This high-density local storage is paired with an 8 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, facilitating large-scale data transfers. No GPU accelerators are present on this instance.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.d1.6xlarge offers a high volume of local HDD storage capacity relative to its compute and memory resources, making it a specialized choice for workloads requiring massive storage density over high-speed random I/O. The lack of SSDs represents a tradeoff, prioritizing raw storage volume over low-latency disk access. This profile is suited for cold data storage, large-scale log processing, data warehousing, and distributed file systems like HDFS.
